relation: adds TRREB market-balance features; target, models, benchmark, metrics and evidence rule identical to v2, whose results stay reported
design: pseudo real-time: latest-vintage data with conservative publication lags; an upper bound on real-time skill
decision_time: end of calendar month T, America/Toronto
trreb_source: data/research/trreb-history.csv (board-wide monthly totals, 2004-01 onward); TRREB month M treated as known at the end of M+1, so features use months up to T-1

definitions.seasonal norm: mean over all earlier calendar years (at least 3) of the same quantity for the same calendar month m; only years before m's year

features.moi_vs_norm: ln MOI3(T-1) minus seasonal norm of ln MOI3
features.snlr_vs_norm: SNLR3(T-1) minus seasonal norm of SNLR3
features.sp_lp_yoy: sale-to-list ratio (T-1) minus (T-13); legacy 'avg % list' and later 'avg SP/LP' are different formulas, so missing when the two months are from different families
features.dom_yoy: 100*ln(DOM(T-1)/DOM(T-13)); legacy/summary DOM and post-2020 LDOM are separate families; missing across families

excluded: sales volume year-over-year (TRREB coverage expansions shift levels); 2002 to mid-2003 (system change)
missing: any required month missing gives no feature value; no imputation

models.benchmark: historical mean of matured targets known at T
models.combination: equal-weight mean of available v3 univariate forecasts

evidence_rule: OOS R2 > 0 over the full OOS period and in both subperiods, and Clark-West one-sided p < 0.05 over the full OOS period
not_allowed: changing features, lags, sample splits or the evidence rule after seeing results
adoption: research evidence only; no dashboard signal
